findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_orvenix_service" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: orvenix_services · Private data: request_orvenix_service · Public sink: request_orvenix_service · Destructive: scan_contract_renewal_terms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: orvenix_services · Private data: request_orvenix_service · Public sink: request_orvenix_service · Destructive: scan_contract_renewal_terms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
